dct_description_sm: The tundra is characterized by 'special bird fauna' where wading birds play a prominent role.  These migratory birds return every year, close to the tree line and higher up the mountain.  Alpine heath is among the most stable natural environment in Sweden, with little anthropogenic disturbance aside from reindeer herding.  Climate change is bringing new challenges, including acid rain and falling nutrients, necessitating monitoring of avian populations.
dct_title_s: Birds of the mountain heaths (Fjllhedens fglar) in Sweden
